eyebrow.zh: 录制、编辑和重放带参数的浏览器流程，用结构化资产保存步骤与定位线索。
eyebrow.en: Record, edit and replay parameterized browser flows with steps and locator clues stored in a structured asset.

headline.zh: 把浏览器操作留成可重放的流程。
headline.en: Keep browser actions as replayable flows.

sub.zh: 录制、编辑和重放带参数的浏览器流程，用结构化资产保存步骤与定位线索。
sub.en: Record, edit and replay parameterized browser flows with steps and locator clues stored in a structured asset.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: JSON 资产能进入代码审阅。
body.en: JSON assets can be reviewed in code.

body.zh: 参数覆盖可复用相同步骤。
body.en: Parameter overrides reuse the same steps.

body.zh: 定位失败时才选择模型修复。
body.en: Choose model repair when locator resolution fails.

body.zh: 登录、填表和提取内容等重复操作，通常包含固定步骤与少量变化参数。FlowCast 把步骤保存为 .flow.json，把输入作为参数注入，方便重跑和审阅。页面变化时先尝试已有定位线索，全部失败后才进入可选的模型修复路径。
body.en: Repeated logins, forms and extraction tasks often share fixed steps with a few changing inputs. FlowCast saves steps in .flow.json and injects input parameters for repeatable review and execution. When a page changes, replay first tries existing locator clues; optional model repair follows only after those fail.

body.zh: 自包含脚本提供完整 HTML 与四步资产，注入 name=Lin 后填写表单并提取结果。没有调用 LLM，也未验证远端网站或自动修复。
body.en: A self-contained script supplies complete HTML and a four-step asset, injects name=Lin, fills the form and extracts the result. It uses no LLM and does not validate remote sites or healing.

alt.en: A self-contained script supplies complete HTML and a four-step asset, injects name=Lin, fills the form and extracts the result. It uses no LLM and does not validate remote sites or healing.

body.zh: asset.ts 的 Zod schema 定义动作、参数与 SelectorBundle。record 捕获浏览器操作，params 解析变量，replay 用 Playwright 执行 goto/fill/click/select/waitFor/extract。heal 将 DOM 与线索提交给配置的模型并记录 healHistory；编辑器在本地提供资产修改界面。
body.en: The Zod schema in asset.ts defines actions, parameters and SelectorBundle. record captures browser actions, params resolves variables and replay executes goto/fill/click/select/waitFor/extract through Playwright. heal submits DOM and clues to the configured model and records healHistory; the local editor updates assets.

alt.en: The Zod schema in asset.ts defines actions, parameters and SelectorBundle. record captures browser actions, params resolves variables and replay executes goto/fill/click/select/waitFor/extract through Playwright. heal submits DOM and clues to the configured model and records healHistory; the local editor updates assets.

body.zh: 正常重放无需模型。record 与 edit 需要交互式浏览器；validate 只检查资产结构与参数。启用 heal 后，页面 DOM 会发送给所配置的 Chat Completions 服务。
body.en: Normal replay needs no model. record and edit use an interactive browser; validate checks asset structure and parameters only. With heal enabled, page DOM is sent to the configured Chat Completions service.

body.zh: 自愈读取 `FLOWCAST_LLM_API_KEY`（或 OPENAI_API_KEY）、`FLOWCAST_LLM_BASE_URL` 与 `FLOWCAST_LLM_MODEL`。步骤可设置 timeoutMs；冗余线索包括 CSS、XPath、role/name、text 与结构位置。示例不含私有凭证；实际资产中的填充值应自行检查。
body.en: Healing reads `FLOWCAST_LLM_API_KEY` (or OPENAI_API_KEY), `FLOWCAST_LLM_BASE_URL` and `FLOWCAST_LLM_MODEL`. Steps accept timeoutMs and redundant CSS, XPath, role/name, text and structural clues. The example contains no private credentials; inspect values in real recorded assets.

note.zh: 自包含脚本提供完整 HTML 与四步资产，注入 name=Lin 后填写表单并提取结果。没有调用 LLM，也未验证远端网站或自动修复。
note.en: A self-contained script supplies complete HTML and a four-step asset, injects name=Lin, fills the form and extracts the result. It uses no LLM and does not validate remote sites or healing.

body.zh: 返回 ok=true、stepsRun=4 与 Hello, Lin。
body.en: Returns ok=true, stepsRun=4 and Hello, Lin.

body.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+ 和 Chromium。演示启动临时本地 HTTP 服务，使用真实无头浏览器访问，不需要远端站点。
body.en: Requires Node.js 22+ and Chromium. The example starts a temporary local HTTP server and uses a real headless browser, without a remote site.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/flowcast.git
cd flowcast
npm ci
npm run build
npx playwright install chromium

limitations.zh: 页面布局、认证和业务逻辑变化都可能使资产失效，重放或模型修复不保证永久成功。
limitations.en: Layout, authentication and business-logic changes can invalidate an asset; replay and model repair do not guarantee permanent success.

limitations.zh: 演示仅测试本地表单重放，没有测试录制 UI 或实际模型修复。
limitations.en: The demo tests local-form replay, not the recording UI or live-model repair.
